Moon Anforas periodically spawn on the ground, dropping a Gold Coin when they are destroyed and is automatically collected. Every 10 seconds, up to 18 amphoras can be spawned just outside the screen, the amount depending on the players
Amphoras start despawning if more than 100 are on the stage at a time. Amphoras do not despawn if the player moves too far from them but are teleported back to the edges of the screen instead.
When entering Moongolow with one of the following characters:

The player will experience a special sequence of events. During this event (dubbed the lunar eclipse event), the background will gradually turn red and the music will become detuned. Different sets of enemies will spawn at the 12th minute mark onward. At the 14th minute mark, a fish-eye effect is applied to the screen, a large amount of eyeballs begin circling the player, and a special, angel-like boss is spawned. If the boss is defeated, the screen will become increasingly distorted, and after a minute, the game will "freeze". After a couple of seconds, the player will unlock and automatically teleport to
. After clearing Holy Forbidden, the eclipse event will be disabled.
Whether a character is eligible to access this sequence is indicated by a glowing blood moon that appears on Moongolow's title card during stage selection.
Note that clearing Holy Forbidden will not unlock any normal unlocks for the run (even if the player normally qualifies for them). Only unlocks related to the
and the eclipse will be unlocked.
